children: The Fed's chief of staff, Michelle Smith, called on one final reporter just about 28 minutes into Warsh's press conference, which wrapped up promptly by 3 p.m. This is a shorter press conference than we've seen in recent times. They routinely ran another 15 minutes or so. Yet Warsh still took questions from a broad group of reporters. He cut time by taking only one question per reporter.
